question: Does any existing specialist improve a shared state once an adversary has revealed a pattern? Before adding a hierarchical controller, measure whether the best standalone policy changes across a declared opponent or own-view landmark.
development: Only the eight previously exposed development selection donors. Compare W-tap, Hold-W, v1 hybrid, anti-Hold and anti-hybrid on identical starts, 0/80ms and both seats. Then fork the same complete game after the first local defensive signal or a local outward-moving edge signal, with all alternatives primed over the actual observations/actions. Include an unchanged prefix continuation and W-tap at each state. Variance across clocks stays visible.
gate: Consider a learned within-fight expert selector only if different specialists are better on different opponent groups or common mid-fight states. Do not use prospective clocks for feature or policy construction. Every playable selector must rely solely on its own client and be tested against both fixed experts and W-tap natively.
